mechanisms.ROI_GAP: guard_inputs profiles.core admission uses adaptive-core certificate but does not measure legacy fixed3px-eroded profile ROI. guard_raw uses matching adaptive-core actual scalar. This is interface ROI mismatch, not a source swap or broken old seal.
mechanisms.COMPOSITE_GUARD: MIXED vs ACTIVITY changes mixture detection, native-source ownership/coverage and scalar-MAD eligibility together. Cannot assign all effect to mixture detection alone.
